system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

a different population would not explain the excess mortality.", "refs": ["f_ce96d57674b2f5"]}], "would_settle": "Not applicable."}, {"category": "design_or_endpoint", "status": "weakened", "for": [], "against": [{"text": "Trial was a standard event-driven CVOT with a composite MACE endpoint; early stopping was triggered by safety signal, not design flaw.", "refs": ["f_f97cac47df96af", "f_ce96d57674b2f5", "f_df29965f308195"]}], "would_settle": "Not applicable."}, {"category": "execution_or_nonscientific", "status": "weakened", "for": [], "against": [{"text": "Trial was well-executed (15,067 randomized), stopped by independent DSMB for safety, not for operational failure.", "refs": ["f_19d51e14bec244", "f_df29965f308195"]}], "would_settle": "Not applicable."}, {"category": "insufficient_data", "status": "weakened", "for": [], "against": [{"text": "Key facts are available: biomarker changes, BP safety signal, DSMB termination reason, genetic evidence, and trial size. The harm signal and its off-target mechanism are well documented.", "refs": ["f_05ae899bd8c92a", "f_3c00b6042dfc32", "f_ce96d57674b2f5", "f_c145d8bc469bf7", "f_19d51e14bec244"]}], "would_settle": "Not applicable."}], "primary_category": "off_target_harm", "secondary_categories": ["target_not_causal", "biomarker_not_causal"], "confidence": "high", "departure_from_calculator": "Calculator returned 'insufficient_data' because pathway was not quantifiable and no observed HR was provided. However, the autopsy-mode readout (DSMB termination for excess mortality/CV events) and verified safety signals (BP elevation) provide direct evidence of off-target harm. The calculator's 'weakest_link: target genetics: not_causal' is noted but secondary to the demonstrated off-target toxicity that explains the harm."}

response: {"headline": "ILLUMINATE (torcetrapib) was stopped for harm on 2006-12-02 after the DSMB found an imbalance of mortality and cardiovascular events, driven by an off-target blood pressure elevation not shared by other CETP inhibitors.", "summary": "The ILLUMINATE trial randomized 15,067 patients with established cardiovascular disease and low HDL-C (men <44 mg/dL, women <54 mg/dL) to torcetrapib plus atorvastatin versus atorvastatin alone, with a primary endpoint of time to first major cardiovascular event. On 2006-12-02, the independent DSMB recommended termination because of an imbalance of mortality and cardiovascular events. Phase 2 data showed torcetrapib raised HDL-C by 40–100% (e.g., 40.2% on atorvastatin background, 54.5%, 106%, 136% across studies) and lowered LDL-C by ~19–22% (e.g., -18.9% on atorvastatin, -22.2%), but also caused small dose-dependent increases in systolic and diastolic blood pressure — an off-target effect linked to aldosterone elevation and adrenal toxicity. The calculator, run in forecast mode, returned not_computable (category insufficient_data) with an expected HR of 0.95 (5% RRR) based on LDL-C lowering, assuming a baseline LDL-C of 2.0 mmol/L and noting 11,728 events would be needed for 80% power. Its weakest link was target genetics coded as not_causal (Open Targets CETP genetic association score 0.736). The autopsy verdict is stopped_harm with primary category off_target_harm (supported), secondary categories target_not_causal and biomarker_not_causal (both supported), and high confidence. The departure from the calculator is that the readout and verified safety signals provide direct evidence of off-target harm, whereas the calculator could not quantify the pathway.", "key_evidence": ["DSMB termination for imbalance of mortality and cardiovascular events (Pfizer press release Dec 2, 2006 (Exhibit 99 to Form 8-K): In Interests of Patient Safety, Pfizer Stops All Torcetrapib Clinical Trials)", "15,067 participants randomized (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00134264 ILLUMINATE)", "Primary endpoint: time to first major cardiovascular disease event (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00134264 ILLUMINATE)", "Calculator: expected HR 0.95, causal RRR 5%, category insufficient_data, weakest_link target genetics not_causal (calculator)", "Calculator assumptions: LDL-C baseline assumed 2.0 mmol/L; events needed for 80% power: 11,728 (calculator)", "Open Targets CETP genetic association score 0.736 (opentargets:CETP)", "HDL-C increases: 40.2% on atorvastatin background (Efficacy and safety of torcetrapib, a novel cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, in individuals with below-average high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels on a background of atorvastatin), 54.5% (Efficacy and safety of torcetrapib, a novel cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, in individuals with below-average high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels), 106% (Effects of an inhibitor of cholesteryl ester transfer protein on HDL cholesterol), 136% (Effects of cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibition on high-density lipoprotein subspecies, apolipoprotein A-I metabolism, and fecal sterol excretion)", "LDL-C decreases: -18.9% on atorvastatin background (Efficacy and safety of torcetrapib, a novel cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, in individuals with below-average high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels on a background of atorvastatin), -22.2% (Efficacy and safety of torcetrapib, a novel cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, in individuals with below-average high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels)", "Blood pressure increases: small increases in systolic and diastolic BP (Efficacy and safety of torcetrapib, a novel cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, in individuals with below-average high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels on a background of atorvastatin); significant BP increases in 2 of 140 subjects (Efficacy and safety of torcetrapib, a novel cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, in individuals with below-average high-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels)"], "what_would_change_this": "The harm signal is definitive; the trial was stopped. Only earlier recognition of the off-target blood pressure effect (e.g., from phase 1/2 data) could have prevented the trial or led to a different dose selection.", "readthrough_note": "Other CETP inhibitors (dalcetrapib, anacetrapib, evacetrapib) lacked the blood pressure elevation; anacetrapib's REVEAL trial later showed neutral cardiovascular outcomes, confirming the harm was specific to torcetrapib's off-target toxicity, not a class effect of CETP inhibition or HDL-C raising."}
